name: MiniMax H3 — first / last frame to video with sound
description:
Grow a short film with its own soundtrack from a written scene, and optionally pin how it starts and how it ends.

Give a FIRST frame and the clip begins there. Give a LAST frame and it arrives there. Give both and the model travels between them — the classic way to animate between two stills. Give neither and it is plain text-to-video. Every combination is allowed; a slot you leave empty is removed from the graph, so it cannot influence the result.

Still describe the motion in the prompt: the frames say where to start and finish, the words say what happens in between and what is heard. Fast mode runs the 4-step turbo LoRA; switch it off for the 20-step path when a clip matters more than the wait.

A first/last frame works best when the two pictures share a subject and a camera position — hand the model an impossible jump and it will invent a cut.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 video prompt guide — MiniMax
promptGuides.tip: Start with the overall style and opening framing, then describe what happens in order. Name camera moves with their speed ("slowly pulls out"), and describe sounds and music concretely — instruments, tempo — rather than moods.
